serialized_markers.scope: Exact named category paths, direct counts, positive caps, DRT source and total count; full marker bodies preserved, not an independent shape-semantic interpretation.

result.scope: Every source CLOCK, fixed, clock-pin or clkbuf-connected net. Signal routing, antenna, RC and timing remain separate.

projection.identity_scope: Raw wire operands remain database OIDs. Named parents and anonymous container ordinals below are scoped observation identities, never database OIDs or claims of cross-serialization ordinal stability.

ownership.scope: All ordinary raw opcode-derived boxes, every via component, every connected/disconnected native placed terminal pin, special-wire boxes/vias and transformed decomposed master obstructions. Empty native fill/block-obstruction censuses are mandatory because their instance getters were not exercised. Polygon segmentation identity is not claimed.

classification.selected_role_meaning: clock means exact original selected CLOCK/fixed/clock-pin/clkbuf set; it is not a new semantic clock inference.
